body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> OQO showed world''s smallest mobile pc ‘the Model O2’, which is designed to support Windows Vista operating System at CES 2007. It features a 5-inch wide VGA LCD, a sliding QWERTY keyboard, a pointing stick and a touch-screen panel. It supports EV-DO, WLAN, Bluetooth connectivity.
